auth0-go.why: the smallest case: one external service, Auth0, reached by redirects and by two different client libraries; the same sample written twice, on Gin and on net/http, with nothing joining the two

sveltekit-realworld.why: one SvelteKit app whose pages, form actions and server routes all go to one external REST API; the framework's own tool lists the routes

microblog.why: one Flask app with blueprints, a database through an ORM, a job queue with its worker, mail, a search engine and a translation API

next-subscriptions.why: one Next.js app between two services that call each other through it: Supabase for login and data, Stripe for checkout, with a webhook that writes back

bank-of-anthos.why: several services in two languages (Python and Java) that call each other over HTTP with a signed token, two databases, and a load generator
